mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 10 degrees now, few clouds. Next 24 hours: high 12, low 7.

A federal judge has temporarily blocked President Donald Trump's plan to close a historic golf course and its surrounding park in Washington, D.C.

A Jordanian court sentenced three men to death for the armed attack on a church that killed nine people and injured 34.

Two aircraft collided at Miami International Airport on Saturday evening, leaving at least two people with minor injuries.

Bahrain announced it intercepted and destroyed several Iranian drone attacks, while Tehran claimed it struck a U.S. military base in the Persian Gulf.

Hamas said an Israeli airstrike killed a senior Hamas commander who helped plan the October 7, 2023 attack on Israel.
